messages:
maria: Heads up — aiming to cut the 2.14.0 runtime + router + api + console push in the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window tonight. Requesting pin for these cross-service dependencies so we don't get mid-rollout drift.

maria: Summary: runtime v2.14.0 (KV eviction fix), router v1.9.3 (header-split rollback hook), api v3.2.0 (compat shim), console v0.23.1 (dashboard telemetry).

maria: Plan is sequenced fanout: api -> runtime -> router -> console. Small canary (2% traffic) after api, then ramp if metrics clear.

deploy-bot: preflight checks starting for release 2.14.0 (initiated by @maria). Running integrated schema/pin checks...

deploy-bot: preflight: model-compat OK, schema diff: none, pinned-variants: api@3.2.0, runtime@2.14.0, router@1.9.3, console@0.23.1

sam: ping — any special rollback criteria besides latency/error-rate thresholds?

maria: yes. Primary rollback triggers: 1) 5m sustained p50 latency > 2x baseline for api/runtime; 2) error rate > 1% on production routes; 3) KV eviction anomalies (see runtime logs). If any of these happen during canary, we abort and pin to previous variants across all services.

jordan: remind me — do we have circuit-breaker configured on router for header-split? Want automatic traffic cut if header mismatch spikes.

lee: router has a header-split circuit with a 10s cooldown. But that only triggers per-shard; for global we rely on the orchestrator to stop rollout. We should add an explicit manual stop step in the runbook.

maria: good call. I'll add: if router header mismatch >0.5% for 3 minutes, pause rollout and escalate to @sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: noted. I'll be on standby 01:45-03:30 UTC. If we get rollback signal, I'll coordinate cross-service pin and evacuate canaries.

deploy-bot: smoke tests passed in staging. Load test snapshot attached: https://internal-ci/reports/7360001111-smoke (open internally).

sam: release notes link? Want to flag consumer-facing contract changes.

maria: release notes drafted here: https://docs.internal/releases/2.14.0 (will add console screenshots). No public API changes, only internal compat shim — but callouts for ops about KV eviction change.

release-engineering: request: schedule a 15m hold window after the canary ramp to validate telemetry ingestion and APM traces. Ops wants to confirm KV cache behavior under real traffic.

maria: added 15m verification gate post-ramp. Sequence now: api canary -> wait 10m -> runtime canary -> wait 10m -> router canary -> wait 15m verification -> console deploy.

jordan: small nit — can we pin the console rollout to not auto-update the user-facing telemetry collector? We want console to be applied last and manually flip the collector flag.

maria: yes, console deploy will be manual and require an explicit dashboard flag flip. I'll set console to paused in the orchestrator and we flip once verification passes.

deploy-bot: canary rollout plan created. Orchestrator job ID: orch-7360001111. Attachments: config diff, pinned variants, canary percentages.

lee: quick check — are there any data-migration steps? I assume none but double-checking KV eviction TTL default change is backward compatible.

maria: confirmed: TTL default change is safe for reads; only affects eviction aggressiveness under OOM which is what the fix targets. No migrations.

sam: I'll be watching api metrics and will post a short summary at each gate.

sre-oncall: if we need to rollback, preferred order: 1) pause orchestrator, 2) pin all services to previous variants, 3) run quick smoke and then notify customers if degrade expected >5min.

maria: agreed. Also adding a postmortem hold: if we roll back, hold release for 72h and open a critical postmortem channel.

jordan: anything for change window ops? I can reserve the change window with platform and notify support.

maria: thanks — please post the support note and incident contact list into #incidents before the window.

deploy-bot: preflight completed successfully. No blocking issues reported. Orchestrator job queued for 2026-03-22T02:10:00Z.

lee: one last ask — include the exact revert commands in the runbook (kubectl/ops-runner aliases) so we can flip quickly.

maria: done. Runbook snippet added (pull args below):
```
# rollback quick steps
orchctl pause orch-7360001111
orchctl pin api=3.1.7 runtime=2.13.9 router=1.9.2 console=0.23.0
ops-runner smoke api/runtime router
```

maria: OK team — thanks. Will start the run at 02:10 UTC. Ping here when your gate checks are complete. :rocket:

sam: acknowledged — I'll post canary metrics updates.

jordan: reserved the window and added support notification.

sre-oncall: on-call standby confirmed.

deploy-bot: orchestrator started. Will post progress updates and final status to this thread.
